questions.text:
3. [Maximum mark: 9]
The daily rainfall in a holiday resort follows a normal distribution with mean µmm
and standard deviation σmm. The rainfall each day is independent of the rainfall on
other days.
On a randomly chosen day, there is a probability of 0.05 that the rainfall is greater
than 10.2mm.
In a randomly chosen 7-day week, there is a probability of 0.025 that the mean daily
rainfall is less than 6.1 mm.
Find the value of µ and of σ. [9 marks]
